change_summary: Changed grid from (64, 1, 1) to (64, 1024, 1) and fixed A/B pointer arithmetic by decomposing idx_q into batch_idx = idx_q // 8 and head_idx = idx_q % 8, using per-batch strides stride_ab = stride_bb = 393216 alongside per-head strides stride_aq = stride_bq = 49152 to correctly address all 1024 BMM batch slices in parallel.
